reasons: The cited clause (three-year, USD 2,000,000/year take-or-pay 'without reduction or termination rights') is squarely the MINCOMMIT walk-away position, so 'deviation' is correctly classified.

The redline reaches the preferred position — no minimum/volume/take-or-pay commitment, non-binding forecasts, and Fees payable only for Services ordered or used — and is directionally correct in Customer's favour.

The failed minimal-edit heuristic (0.923 changed-character ratio) is expected here: the rule's redline guidance calls for deleting or replacing the take-or-pay obligation, which cannot be done with a small in-place tweak; the replacement adds no unrelated obligations on Vendor.

The comment is concise, in-house tone, cites the playbook position, notes the internal conflict with Sections 7.1 and 12.3, and offers the fallback (12-month term, 30 days' notice reduction, true-up not penalty) as required.
